notes: Fixes from your first run on the PC. The video no longer leaves a grey box on the page after it stops, and it moves beside the sound/subtitle list instead of disappearing. Check my library no longer counts parts of one episode, extras or editions as copies, and judges small files against their whole folder. More folders match MyAnimeList (titles with [X], films named like the anime they're based on are left alone), and one click uses Plex's old match for the shows AniBox couldn't match. Show pages get AniList's description without a MyAnimeList Client ID.
